director.name: Federico Moreno Torroba Federico Moreno Torroba

introduction: In a parallel world where animals live as humans, an authoritarian law places a city in a state of chaos. The ‘Darwin Code’ mandates conformity to species-specific by-laws where individual expression is prohibited and heavily enforced by militarized droids who punish any that challenge the code.  But a subversive group resists and lights a flame for others to follow.  This group is known only as the ‘Rebels’.
